detail: AMLNet is generated; learned patterns reflect generator rules as much as real laundering behaviour.
Transaction category and type dominate importance, indicating strong generator-side signal rather than subtle behavioural detection.
Engineered balance and amount features are correlated, so importance is shared and single attributions should not be read alone.
SHAP shows what the model responded to, not that laundering occurred.
Stratified random split does not replicate chronological or account-disjoint deployment conditions.
